challenger.notes: The diagnosis, narrow correction boundary, endpoint-scoped serialization option, and exact same-pass regression align with the historical implementation and review. However, it supplies the exact held-out future DEV report path while simultaneously stating that no completed report can be claimed; that also makes the declared DEV route and handoff internally inconsistent.

champion.notes: Correctly identifies the same-pass per-endpoint admission race, preserves existing capacity and durable waiting ownership, stays narrow, and proposes a defect-sensitive concurrency regression. However, its requirement to use existing synchronization primitives conflicts with the accepted worker-owned per-endpoint lock, and it does not cover the later demonstrated continuation-started crash window.
